name: inverted-colors
plain: True if the OS inverts colors (Safari Smart Invert).
meaning: Accessibility setting visible only in Safari and WebKit browsers. Used by FingerprintJS as a Safari-only trait.

access.persistence: read fresh on every page load; nothing stored
access.iframe: Readable from cross-origin iframes too (same values)

limits.headline: Can tell if your device inverts screen colors, such as Smart Invert on iPhone
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page loads.
can: Check whether inverted colors are on
Keep images and video looking normal
Add the answer to a browser fingerprint
cannot: Tell why you turned it on, though it can hint at a vision need
Get an answer in Chrome, Firefox or on Android
limits.reach_label: One yes or no, no prompt
limits.differs: Only Safari on iPhone and Mac reports it. Other browsers say nothing.

story.what_it_is: Tells a page whether your device has inverted colors turned on, as Safari Smart Invert does.

marketing.name: inverted-colors media feature
marketing.pitch: Documents a media query that tells a page when the operating system is inverting colors.

story.for_you: You never see the check. If you have Smart Invert on, a good site can fix photos and logos that would otherwise look like negatives.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to avoid washed out images and broken brand colors. It is rarely used, but it can hint that the person uses an accessibility setting.

use_cases.example: A news site keeps photos in their true colors while the rest of the page is inverted.
A photo site restores true colors on pictures so faces do not look like negatives.
A browser card game keeps card suits red and black even when the system inverts colors.
A store keeps product colors true so shoppers do not buy the wrong shade.
A drawing app warns that the screen colors are inverted so you do not misjudge your work.
A privacy aware team avoids recording the value since it can mark a vision need.

legit_uses: Respect OS theme and accessibility needs
abuse: Infer disability or setting for fingerprinting
